note: A Phase 3 plan with mining per phase (Miner Mk.2, Mk.4 belts, Mk.2 pipes, no Power Shards), calculated by origin/main 0ca2007e before #1169, and the step ids its build plan listed per phase then.

warnings: Resource budgets are provisional. Confirm available extraction after reserving resources for existing factories.

Each phase's resource budgets follow the miners, belts and pipes its milestones unlock (Miner Mk.2 at 100% in Phase 3 and Mk.3 at 250% in Phases 4 and 5): a node gives no more than its belt or pipe carries, crude oil comes from Phase 3 and resource wells from Phase 4. Until you can overclock, miners and oil extractors run at 100% in Phases 1–3, and from Phase 2 the build plan says how many miners researching Power Shards in the MAM (Blue Power Slugs, then Overclock Production) would save; once you can, turn on “I can overclock” with Edit settings. From Phase 4 they run overclocked up to 250%, never more than their belt or pipe carries. The entered budgets are the most any phase draws.
Phase targets assume that phase’s milestones and required MAM research are unlocked. Gathered items, buildings and equipment are not continuously automated.

Power includes new generators and their fuel chains, the miners and extractors (Miner Mk.2 at 100% in Phase 3 and Mk.3 at 250% in Phases 4 and 5, on the nodes each phase taps), and a 20% allowance on the production lines for trains, drone ports and pumps. Machines count at their clocked power; Particle Accelerators, Converters and Quantum Encoders at their peak. Generators are whole and run at 100%, burning fuel only for the power drawn, and a phase keeps the generators the phase before built. Existing plants are represented only by spare capacity; subtract their fuel from available resources. Drone fuel is a separate protected supply contract, not a route-consumption estimate.
Maximum output optimizes elevator completion within the entered budgets and allowed recipes; it is not an unrestricted global game optimum.
